name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Exactly one of these is true: Bell goes with Steel; Tesla goes with Steel; Tungsten goes with Drill.
Laser goes with at least one of Bell, Aluminum, or Tungsten.
Drill goes with none of Hertz, Copper, or Tungsten.
Either Bell goes with Blowtorch or Laser goes with Tesla.
Aluminum, Copper, and Steel go with Ford, Tesla, and Laser, in some order.
Either Ford goes with Steel or Caliper goes with Tesla.

Suppose Tungsten went with Laser — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Tungsten goes with Laser.
Laser goes with Tungsten, so Aluminum can't go with Laser.
Laser goes with Tungsten, so Copper can't go with Laser.
Laser goes with Tungsten, so Steel can't go with Laser.
…but now the clue “Aluminum, Copper, and Steel go with Ford, Tesla, and Laser, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Tungsten does not go with Laser.
